name: Glider Nut
summary: Glide far. Land hard. Go again. A Fat Cat cannon fires a flying squirrel into five themed endless runs. Tap, click or press Space to flap, and release to glide. Thread obstacle gaps for points, collect acorns, and read the wind: gusts push you up or down, while updrafts and steam can carry you through. Fly through Old Oak Hollow, Suburbia, Purrsonnel Campus, The Cannery and the Acorn Exchange, past ravens, low limbs and swinging hazards.
